overview: WE Hub is a Government of Telangana initiative aimed at empowering women entrepreneurs by providing access to technical, financial, government, and policy support to start, scale, sustain, and accelerate their businesses. It focuses on fostering innovation and leadership among women in both urban and rural areas to drive social empowerment through economic enablement. The hub offers a range of services including business consultation, mentorship, marketing assistance, compliance and tax support, funding assistance, and community networking. It works with startups, SMEs, and students, aligning its efforts with 12 of the 17 UN Sustainable Development Goals.
objectives: Build a powerful community of 1 million women entrepreneurs across India
Transform the entrepreneurial landscape by fostering innovation and leadership among women
Counter biases and stereotypes faced by women entrepreneurs
Enable access to technical, financial, government, and policy support
Support women to start, scale, sustain, and accelerate their businesses
Promote social empowerment through economic enablement
Engage with communities and institutions to advance 12 of the 17 UN SDGs
Provide skill development and entrepreneurial training for students
eligibility: Women entrepreneurs must hold at least 51% stake in their business, which must be legally registered in India. For specific programs like WE Reach, applicants must be women or groups of 2-3 women from Tier 2/Tier 3 regions of Telangana who want to set up a for-profit enterprise or are running an informal enterprise and wish to formalize it. For Project Inclusion, applicants must be registered enterprises in operation for two years with a woman holding at least 51% stake and turnover between INR 5 lakhs – 10 lakhs per annum (relaxable for Handicrafts sector). For WE Leads, applicants must be women entrepreneurs owning at least 51% of a registered business operational for at least 2 years, serving as executive decision-makers, and demonstrating scalability and growth potential.
benefits: Access to business consultation, entrepreneurial and management courses, business mentorship, marketing assistance for early-stage and established startups, compliance and tax assistance, funding and financial assistance guidance, community and networking opportunities, sector-specific mentoring, skill enhancement programs, internship and live project opportunities, patenting and IP support, credit linkage, Udyam and MSME registration support, and participation in hackathons and exposure visits.
financial_support: WE Hub provides guidance and linkages to funding sources but does not directly disburse grants or loans. Financial support is facilitated through partnerships, including access to grants, seed funding, angel investors, venture capitalists, corporate partners, and recoverable grants such as the USD 2.5 crores from USAID via Samridh Healthcare Blended Finance Facility. Some programs like Project Inclusion are CSR-funded (e.g., by Re-Sustainability Limited), while WE Leads is a paid program. WE Hub has supported ventures in securing external funding, including PMEGP loans (e.g., ₹3.10 lakh) through its programs.
application_process: 1. Identify the suitable program based on business stage (e.g., WE Reach for pre-incubation, Project Inclusion for incubation, WE Leads for acceleration). 2. Check eligibility criteria specific to the program (e.g., geographic, turnover, stakeholding requirements). 3. Prepare required documents including business registration, PAN, pitch deck, and stakeholder details. 4. Apply via the designated email address for the program (e.g., fo-sie-wehub@telangana.gov.in for SIE programs, pm-wehub@telangana.gov.in for Project Ujaagar). 5. Await confirmation and further instructions from the WE Hub team regarding selection and onboarding.
required_documents: Details of stakeholding (to confirm ≥51% women ownership)
Proof of turnover or business operation duration (if applicable)
Details of prior funding received (if any)
deadlines: Rolling basis — programs operate in cohorts (e.g., 4 cohorts per year for WE Reach) with specific intake windows; applicants are advised to check with the respective program coordinators for upcoming cycles.
contact_details: Phone: +91 93921 84664 | Email: info@wehub.org.in | Address: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Open University Campus, Road No. 45, Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad, Telangana 500033
caveats: Program-specific eligibility criteria apply (e.g., geographic restrictions to Tier 2/Tier 3 regions for WE Reach)
Some programs are paid (e.g., WE Leads), while others are free or CSR-funded
Home-based units are not encouraged for certain programs like Project Inclusion
Part-time engagement in the enterprise may disqualify applicants for incubation and acceleration programs
Funding support is facilitative; WE Hub does not directly provide grants or loans
Specific programs may have sectoral focus (e.g., Project Inclusion focuses on Manufacturing, Food Processing, FMCG, Textiles & Handlooms, Handicrafts)
